title: Engineering-admitted glossary term
description: A bounded Engineering admission profile derived from the Science term record: the same source fields and assertion values, with a closed carrier field set and only source-declared relation predicates. This profile is not the scientific source type.

identity.description: Stable carrier identity, normally equal to the Markdown filename stem.

body.description: Definition and distinctions carried for readers.

description.description: Concise independent summary of the concept.

consent-status.description: Freeform consent or access designation carried with the term (the corpus speaks of kin-gated, season-gated, and protocol-gated regions but fixes no value set). Any nonempty string is admitted; the vocabulary of consent-status values is explicitly deferred.

visibility.description: Which publication surface may carry the term, under the house surface policy: "public" opts the term into the anonymous surface (the public glossary vocabulary, the knowledge garden's public tree); absent or "authenticated" keeps it to signed-in readers. Only the term's own carrier can open it to the public.

type.description: The semantic kind instantiated by the resource. This is a resource tag, not a document-format label.

creator.description: The entity that created the resource, when that claim is part of the term's semantics.

aliases.description: Other designations admitted for this concept in the same glossary scope.

keywords.description: Retrieval or compound-composition keys; they are not aliases by default.

relations.description: An Engineering admission of Science term relations: the only legal keys are original source-owned relation predicates, whose ranges are declared as carrier or literal in relation-predicates.json.

references.description: Published evidence keyed by citekey, separate from semantic relations.

utterances.description: Content addresses of the Leader utterances the record was written from, as the leader-utterances records name them.

provenance.description: Custody, carrier metadata, dates, and the Leader utterances the record answers, separate from its semantic assertions. date-created/date-modified/date-updated/authors/tags/id/domain/scheme/status are carrier bookkeeping keys folded here by the admission path when a carrier states them at frontmatter top level; they are never admitted as relations.

params.description: The status function's capability signature (kappa_R): named argument slots and their types.

ast.description: The status function's constitutive structure, per the 2026-04-08 note on FARS algebraic readings of work terms. Nested object, array, or string shapes all occur in the corpus; the value is carried verbatim.

output.description: The status function's declared output type or structure.

status-function.description: FARS status-function declaration metadata (Searle's status functions, formalized in the 2026-04-08 note on FARS algebraic readings of work terms). params/ast/output are carrier bookkeeping folded here by the admission path when a carrier states them at frontmatter top level; they are never admitted as relations and never dropped.
